raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go) (m/w/d)
raw.description:
About us

As one of Germany's leading HealthTech companies, we are transforming discharge management by making it technology driven, patient centered, and free of bureaucracy. In addition to our market leading SaaS platform, we are developing AI solutions that radically simplify processes in clinics and for aftercare providers, relieve the burden on healthcare professionals, and put the focus back on patients. We currently connect over two thirds of all German hospitals with more than 650 rehabilitation clinics, and over 25,000 care and homecare providers. With around 120 employees from a broad range of nations, we are continuing to grow and are looking for people with the right attitude who want to improve the healthcare system alongside us.

We're now going far beyond our core business, aiming to eliminate bureaucracy and admin in hospitals with a whole portfolio of AI products.

What you'll work on

Aftercare provider operations are becoming increasingly complex and data driven. Bringing change is very hard, but we're not afraid. You'll build features that help care facilities, rehabilitation centers, and healthcare chains better allocate resources, unlock actionable insights from patient data, and integrate Recare seamlessly into their internal systems.

Our ambitious roadmap focuses on expanding our marketplace's receiver side with enhanced analytics tools, B2C platforms connecting providers directly with patients, expanded API integrations, and much more.

Secure communication is at our core. Our solution provides end to end encryption for healthcare professionals to safely exchange messages and patient data through both our applications and external API integrations.


In this role, you will:

  • Own a domain inside our core Go codebase, contributing to architecture decisions and code quality within your area

  • Work inside a well structured system with some standalone services around the edges, including an on premise gateway for hospital integrations, rather than a sprawling microservices estate

  • Step in and keep things moving when your lead is away, taking ownership with confidence rather than waiting for instruction

  • Contribute to pull requests, reviews, and technical discussions as a trusted senior voice on your team

We have several products in development that we are confident will significantly impact the German healthcare system. And yes, we're excited by the new opportunities AI unlocks for building powerful features for our customers and our own workflow.

What technologies you'll work with

  • Golang. Our entire backend codebase is in Golang, and we love it. It's easy to learn, it's strongly typed, the internal tooling is fantastic, and it compiles fast.

  • Postgres. We use Postgres for our databases and GORM to interface with it.

  • CI and DevOps. We use both CircleCI and GitHub Actions to run our unit and integration tests, visual regression tests built in house, and automated code analysis through SonarCloud. They're also used to deploy to our various environments.

We also dedicate some of our time to work on non business tasks, which means for instance:

  • Continuously optimising the backend code to offer the best user experience

  • Analysing and improving database slowdowns and issues

  • Internal automation, because we want to make our lives easier

  • Building additional tooling, such as performance profiling tools to identify bottlenecks in backend services and optimise resource usage

Our philosophy is that developers are owners of the code they write until it gets to production. We rely a lot on automated tests to ensure everything stays stable. The rule is that code could be deployed at any time, and manual QA is only involved in new feature validation.


This is what you can expect from us

  • Work with Purpose. Your work has a real impact on patients and healthcare professionals in the medical field.

  • Corporate Culture. We embrace structures that foster high performance and strong team dynamics. Our interactions are characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. We work together towards common goals and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility. Would you like to pick up your child from daycare? Do you enjoy exercising during lunchtime? We support you in achieving that balance. Besides flexible working hours, as a remote-first company we offer the flexibility to work 100% remotely from Germany, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Poland, France and Austria.

  • Edenred card, which you can use in the way that suits you best.

  • Extra Day Off on Your Birthday, so you can celebrate with your loved ones.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Backend Engineer will include

  • Technical Ownership. Own a domain inside our Go codebase, contribute to architectural decisions and code quality within your area, identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies and suggest or implement improvements.

  • Stepping Up When Needed. Be ready to take charge of priorities and keep things moving if your lead is away, supporting and mentoring other engineers along the way without needing to manage a team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with product and design to translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate technical progress, risks and trade-offs clearly.

  • Delivery. Ship reliably against the team's roadmap, help break down features into deliverable tasks, and identify and remove blockers as they come up.

  • Building With AI. We are an AI company now, and that shows up in how we expect people to work, not just what we build. Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your day to day, whether that is accelerating how you write and review code, prototyping ideas faster, or finding smarter ways to work. We do not expect you to vibe code everything end to end, plenty of our best engineers still want to write the core of what they ship themselves and use AI to speed things up around the edges. What matters is real curiosity about where this is heading, not scepticism about whether any of this changes how software gets built.



What you will need to succeed as a Senior Backend Engineer:

  • We are looking for experienced developers. You have a CS degree or equivalent knowledge, and you have been coding full time professionally for 4 to 5 plus years

  • We're looking for someone with production experience in Golang, or another C family language with a real, demonstrable ability to operate in Go without hand holding

  • You have some experience supporting or mentoring other engineers, and you are looking for a strong individual contributor role rather than a path into people management

  • You want to become a technical owner of part of our codebase. We need people who are looking for responsibility, just not a team to manage

  • You are a clear, confident communicator, comfortable being put on the spot in a conversation and able to think out loud rather than defaulting to async only communication when something needs a real time answer

  • Since Product and Engineering work in a fully remote setup, writing skills matter more and more, so written questions, requirements, and docs are genuinely valuable

  • You should be comfortable and excited to dive into more advanced topics, for example build pipelines, caching mechanisms, and database optimisation

  • Since we're a small team, we want to automate a lot. You should have experience with CI and testing frameworks

  • You are proactive and proficient across the entire product development flow, asking questions, clarifying specs, raising doubts, and engaging in meetings

  • Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement. FHIR, HL7, or DICOM exposure is great to have, but we have hired strong engineers from fintech, insurtech, and other compliance heavy domains with zero healthcare background who did just fine

  • You are genuinely excited about what AI can do for engineering. We don't expect every line of code to be AI generated, but we do expect curiosity and a real point of view on where this is heading

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
description: Your Mission This is a company built for growth. When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling. As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x) , this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting. If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you. What You'll Own: Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities. Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately. Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work. Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle. Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up. What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations. Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer. Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus. Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself. High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users. Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions. Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information. Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders. Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail. See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved. Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes. Perks that help you focus on what matters. Ihre Aufgaben Sie konzipieren, entwickeln und optimieren KI-Agenten und spezialisierte Skills für interne Arbeitsabläufe. Sie übersetzen Anforderungen aus der Steuerberatung , Wirtschaftsprüfung und Unternehmensberatung in klare und robuste KI-Workflows. Sie unterstützen bei der Anbindung und Nutzung von Datenquellen und Tools , beispielsweise DATEV-Exporte, Tabellen, Dokumente oder interne Wissensbestände. Sie dokumentieren Lösungen verständlich und sorgen dafür, dass Kolleginnen und Kollegen diese sicher anwenden können. Sie verfolgen neue Entwicklungen rund um KI-Agenten , Large Language Models und Automatisierung und bringen geeignete Ideen pragmatisch in die Umsetzung. Ihr Profil Sie studieren Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Digital- oder Technologieschwerpunkt oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für künstliche Intelligenz, insbesondere für Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering oder agentische Workflows. Idealerweise bringen Sie erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, APIs, Datenaufbereitung, Automatisierung oder Vibe Coding mit. Sie arbeiten strukturiert, denken analytisch und geben sich nicht mit einer Antwort zufrieden, nur weil diese überzeugend klingt. Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen. title: Senior Process Engieer
description: ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a cleaner and more innovative future. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. raw.title: Senior Process Engieer
raw.description:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. mechanisms for RDMA, zero-copy data movement, congestion control, transport reliability, and protocol acceleration.</li> <li>Design scalable architectures supporting virtualization, multi-tenant isolation, traffic management, and quality of service.</li> <li>Partner with firmware and software teams to define hardware/software interfaces for initialization, management, telemetry, performance monitoring, and diagnostics.</li> <li>Drive execution from architecture through RTL, integration, verification, tapeout, and post-silicon bring-up.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally to meet performance, timing, power, area, manufacturability, and reliability targets.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer production.</li> <li>Deep expertise in RTL design and microarchitecture for high-performance networking and connectivity ASICs.</li> <li>Extensive experience designing Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC About the Role

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing to build Almetra's marketing function from the ground up. This is a full-stack ownership role — from defining our positioning and narrative to building the initial demand engine and setting the foundation for future scale.

You will work directly with the founders and GTM leadership to shape how the market understands Deltia, create repeatable demand motions, and build the early marketing team over time.

What you’ll do

  • Own positioning and messaging across all customer-facing surfaces

  • Build and execute the go-to-market strategy across digital, content, events and partnerships

  • Design and run demand generation / ABM programs that convert into revenue

  • Create high-leverage content, case studies, and thought leadership with founders and customers

  • Establish marketing metrics, reporting cadence and operational rhythm

  • Gradually build and lead the marketing team as the function scales

You are

  • 5–10 years in B2B SaaS or deep-tech marketing, ideally with enterprise or industrial customer experience

  • Full-stack: strong at both narrative/positioning and performance/demand execution

  • Experienced in building marketing foundations from zero, not just optimizing an existing machine

  • Comfortable working directly with founders and sales to rapidly test and iterate messaging

  • Capable of transitioning from hands-on execution to team leadership as we scale

Why this role matters

You will define how an emerging industrial AI category is perceived — and lay the GTM foundation for the next phase of Deltia’s growth. This is an opportunity to take full ownership, build from first principles and create an iconic category brand.

#LI-Hybrid

What we offer

Employee Share Options Program for all permanent employees*

An increasing benefits list: currently includes Urban Sports club and quarterly team retreats.

Be on the forefront in defining what artificial intelligence means in manufacturing

Gain hands-on experience in working in an AI-first software company

Supportive and inclusive culture that values diversity and promotes the advancement of underrepresented groups within the company

Collaborate with a diverse (currently more than 10 nationalities) and talented team, working on cutting-edge projects with real-world impact

Network with professionals and leaders in the field, opening doors to potential future career opportunities

We have a very flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours

Ethics⚖: We are committed to developing ethical AI software

Don't meet all the requirements?

Almetra is committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, fair, and inclusive. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds, even if they do not meet every qualification, to submit their application. We firmly believe that having a team with diverse perspectives only strengthens our company and drives innovation. Our commitment also extends to providing an accessible environment for everyone, including those with disabilities. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the application process or while working with us, and we will do our best to support you.

*Only full-time, permanent roles are eligible for stock options. Part-time roles, contract roles, work-student, internships and freelance roles are not eligible for stock options.

Die Rolle: Beratung statt einfach nur telefonieren

Bei uns liest Du kein vorgefertigtes Skript ab. Du berätst Unternehmen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz dabei, bessere Arbeitswelten zu gestalten.

  • Qualifizierte Inbound Leads: Vergiss wahlloses „Smile and Dial“. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für hochwertige Leads – Unternehmen, die bereits echtes Interesse an unseren Produkten haben.
  • Pipeline-Aufbau: Du identifizierst relevante Entscheider:innen wie Facility Manager, HR Leads oder Founder und baust eine Pipeline auf, bei der Qualität wichtiger ist als reine Quantität.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kund:innen, führst Discovery Calls und Demos durch und schließt Deine Deals selbst ab. So siehst Du am Ende ganz konkret, wie Deine Arbeit in Form einer mute-labs Box im Büro des Kunden steht.
  • Kein Ellenbogen-Sales: Bei uns gibt es keine Provision. Warum? Weil wir möchten, dass Du das tust, was für den Kunden und das Team am besten ist – nicht das, was Deinen Bonus maximiert. Stattdessen bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, stabiles Fixgehalt, weil wir auf Deine intrinsische Motivation setzen.
So könnte Dein Tag bei uns aussehen

Wir leben eine Office-First-Kultur. Wir glauben, dass die besten Sales-Ideen bei einem gemeinsamen Kaffee entstehen – und nicht in endlosen Slack-Threads.

  • 09:00 | Morning Vibe: Du kommst in unser energiegeladenes Office in Berlin-Mitte, holst Dir einen Kaffee, checkst die neuesten Leads und planst Deinen Tag.
  • 09:30 | Action Phase: Du bist am Telefon oder im Video-Call, sprichst mit neuen Leads über ihre Office-Herausforderungen und vereinbarst Demos.
  • 11:00 | Strategy Huddle: Kurzer Austausch mit Alvaro, unserem Country Manager, oder Jarno, unserem Sales Director, zu einem konkreten Deal oder einem Markttrend, den Du entdeckt hast.
  • 12:30 | Family Table: Wir essen gemeinsam. Freitags kocht ein Team für die ganze Firma. Ob Pasta, Tacos oder ein persönlicher Klassiker – beim gemeinsamen Mittagessen kommen wir als Team zusammen.
  • 14:30 | Market Mastery: Du führst Discovery Demos. Dabei hörst Du mehr zu, als Du redest, und findest heraus, wo beim Kunden wirklich der Schuh drückt.
  • 18:00 | The Close: Du bringst Dein CRM auf den neuesten Stand, aktualisierst Deine Pipeline und machst Feierabend. Deine Offline-Zeit respektieren wir.

Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam ausklingen.

  1. The Spark: Ein kurzer Screening Call mit Lia, um herauszufinden, ob unsere Werte und Vorstellungen zusammenpassen.

verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet: Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

title: Senior Manager Recruiting & Employer Branding (m/f/d)
description: Intro Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet. Du bist ein Talent-Experte und weißt, wie eine Arbeitgebermarke repräsentativ zu etablieren ist und die besten Talente zu gewinnen sind? In unserem People-Team bist Du für den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess der Sanoptis-Gruppe verantwortlich. Du steuerst die Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen in 6 europäischen Ländern (DACH, Spanien, Italien, Griechenland). Du entwickelst und etablierst Best Practices, um die Standardisierung zu erhöhen und Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks zu nutzen. Gemeinsam mit uns etablierst Du Sanoptis als den Employer-of-Choice am Markt. Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf 18 Monate befristet. In dieser Rolle wirst Du Unsere Recruiting-Prozesse entwerfen und steuern : Du trägst die Verantwortung für alle Rekrutierungsaktivitäten der Sanoptis-Gruppe, einschließlich Stellenbeschreibungen, Kanalplanung, Active Sourcing, Bewerberauswahl und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen. Unsere Metriken im Blick behalten und auswerten : Du wirst unsere KPI-Dashboards zur Überwachung der Leistung von Rekrutierungsaktivitäten steuern, auswerten und daraus Daten und evidenzbasierte Handlungen ableiten. Unsere Recruitment-Partner intern und extern steuern : Du wirst Partner wie Stellenportale, Headhunter oder Personalagenturen steuern, Verträge prüfen und Preise verhandeln, um uns stets den besten Zugang zu Talenten zu sichern. Dabei steuerst Du auch Rekrutierungskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam. Zusätzlich schulst Du die Personalverantwortlichen der Kliniken zur Verbesserung ihrer Recruitingaktivitäten. Recruiting mit KI weiterentwickeln : Du beobachtest relevante KI-Trends und nutzt Claude gezielt, um Recruiting-Prozesse zu automatisieren und zu optimieren sowie KI-basierte Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben. Unsere Employer-Brand-Strategie umsetzen : Du stärkst die Sanoptis Employer Brand und entwickelst unsere Außenauftrittem, insbesondere auf LinkedIn, kununu und weiteren relevanten Plattformen, kontinuierlich weiter. Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit Der Head of People Angelina Budes als Deine Führungskraft. Dem globalen People-Team, welches in Recruiting, L&D und People Business Partnering unterteilt ist. Entscheidungsträgern wie Head-ofs, C-Level Executives und Hiring Managern, wenn es um die Einstellung der besten Talente geht. Vielen weiteren Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen durch Hiring-Prozesse, Trainings und weitere Recruiting-Maßnahmen, die Du leitest. Dein Profil überzeugt durch Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Personalwesen. Erfahrung im internationalen Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet. Affinität zu KI-Anwendungen , insbesondere Claude; praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und -Projekten ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit ATS-Systemen (z.B. Personio). Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strategische Fähigkeiten und idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement. Emotionale Intelligenz sowie hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau . Sanoptis bietet Dir Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung : Ein äußerst wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Ziele gebunden ist. Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und sich mit innovativen Ideen einzubringen, dank flacher Hierarchien und kurzer Entscheidungswege, was unsere Organisation stärkt. Berufliche Entwicklung: Nutze die Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Lernen und Wachstum durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen. Inklusive Kultur: Arbeite in einem talentierten und vielfältigen Team mit einer herzlichen Bürokultur und Teamveranstaltungen. Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits. Flexible steuerfreie Benefits : Ein individuelles Benefit-Budget von monatlich 50 €, welches nach persönlichen Bedürfnissen gestaltet und steuerfrei genutzt werden kann. Gleiche Chancen Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle. Kontakt Wenn Du Interesse an dieser spannenden Herausforderung hast und Teil unseres wachsenden Teams werden möchtest, sende uns bitte Deinen Lebenslauf unter Angabe Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung sowie Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Wer wir sind

Die GBC Group GmbH ist eine inhabergeführte IT-Unternehmensgruppe mit über 500 Mitarbeitenden an mehr als 10 Standorten in Deutschland. Nach dem Buy-and-Build-Prinzip vereinen wir 12 spezialisierte Tochtergesellschaften unter einem Dach, jede mit eigener Expertise und einer gemeinsamen Vision. Wir verstehen uns als starker IT-Partner für den deutschen Mittelstand und bieten unseren Kunden ganzheitliche Lösungen entlang der gesamten IT-Wertschöpfungskette: von Managed Services über Cloud-Infrastruktur bis hin zu IT-Security.

Was uns antreibt? Der Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen mit maßgeschneiderter, zuverlässiger IT pragmatisch und partnerschaftlich nach vorne zu bringen.


Dein Wirkungsfeld

Wenn die GBC Group eine Gesellschaft übernimmt, beginnt die eigentliche Arbeit erst danach: Strukturen zusammenführen, Standards etablieren, Führung, Ergebnisse sichtbar machen. Genau hier setzt diese Rolle an. Du bist die Verbindung zwischen der strategischen Agenda der Gruppe und der operativen Realität in den Tochtergesellschaften und trägst die Verantwortung dafür, dass aus Zielen tatsächlich Ergebnisse werden.

Du agierst dabei nicht als Berater, der Empfehlungen abgibt und wieder geht, sondern als jemand, der mit den Geschäftsführern vor Ort Umsetzungen schafft, Widerstände einkalkuliert und trotzdem liefert. Dein Beitrag entscheidet mit darüber, wie schnell und wie erfolgreich eine Integration gelingt.


Deine Aufgaben & Verantwortung

  • Du übersetzt strategische Ziele der Gruppe in konkrete, messbare Projekte gemeinsam mit den Führungskräften vor Ort
  • Du analysierst, definierst und planst Verbesserungsinitiativen aus,- etwa zur Steigerung der operativen Auslastung, zum Aufbau von Führungs- und Reportingstrukturen, zur Prozessoptimierung und Standardisierung oder zur Einführung von IT-Systemen und trackst deren Umsetzung konsequent bis zum Abschluss
  • Du gestaltest die projektbegleitende Kommunikation aktiv und steuerst Stakeholder proaktiv, statt auf Widerstände zu reagieren
  • Du sparrst und coachst Geschäftsführer und Führungskräfte auf Augenhöhe - auch wenn das bedeutet, unbequeme Punkte anzusprechen
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der GBC Group Geschäftsführung PMI-Blueprints und Standards, die für künftige Integrationen wiederverwendbar sind
  • Du reportest transparent an die GBC Group Führung und eskalierst Risiken frühzeitig


Was Du mitbringst

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Zahlenaffinität
  • Beratungshintergrund aus der Prozess-, Strategie- oder IT-Beratung
  • Ausgeprägte Führungs- und Durchsetzungsfähigkeit, Führungserfahrung
  • Projektleitungserfahrung in komplexen Change- und Implementierungsprojekten 
  • Erfahrung in Post-Merger-Integration-Projekten, Operational Excellence
  • Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit klarem Fokus auf das Wesentliche
  • Affinität zu Informationstechnologie, insbesondere zu KI-Systemen
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie einen Führerschein Klasse B
Kann-Kriterien
  • Expertenwissen in M365, vor allem PowerPoint, Excel und Power BI
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar


Was Dich bei uns erwartet

  • Du arbeitest mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und entsprechend wenig Kontrolle im Detail - wir erwarten, dass du Ergebnisse lieferst, nicht dass du Beschäftigung nachweist
  • Deine Entwicklung bei uns hängt an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Titeln oder Betriebszugehörigkeit
  • Reporting und Entscheidungswege sind kurz und direkt, auch zur Geschäftsführung
  • Bis zu 20 % deiner Arbeitszeit kannst du remote gestalten, der überwiegende Teil findet dort statt, wo die Projekte laufen - bei den Tochtergesellschaften in Norddeutschland
  • Leistungsorientierte Kultur: Entwicklung, Förderung und Wertschätzung erfolgen basierend auf tatsächlicher Leistung


Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Run the cadence of standups/status calls, keep everyone accountable to dates, and escalate slippage before it becomes a surprise. Onboarding & Implementation — Guide customers through deployment, integrations, and configuration, so they see value from day one. Product Mastery — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and give customers confidence in how we work. Escalation Management — Be the calm, capable owner of technical escalations — coordinating with engineering and product teams to resolve issues and close the loop with customers. Renewals & Expansion — Partner with our sales team to identify expansion opportunities and ensure strong technical health underpins every renewal opportunity. Customer Advocacy — Bring field insights back to our teams — feature requests, friction points, and what's actually happening in customer environments — so we keep building the right things and ensure the customer remains at the centre of everything we do. Documentation & Enablement — Build the runbooks, guides, and best-practice materials that make onboarding repeatable and support scalable. Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with sales, engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience. Build the Function — As our first UK TAM, help shape the processes and playbooks that define how Geordie supports customers as we scale, in step with the wider TAM function. You own outcomes. You don't wait — you track account health and get ahead of risk before it becomes a churn conversation. You're a builder. Early-stage means you create structure where there isn't any and find a way to provide value to customers. You're AI-fluent, not just AI-aware. You use tools like Claude Cowork and other agentic AI to run your own workflow — drafting runbooks, triaging tickets, prepping QBRs, chasing account health signals — so you spend your time on judgement calls and relationships, not repetitive admin. You look for the next task to hand off to an agent before you look for the next hire. You earn trust at every level. You can debug an integration issue with an engineer in the morning and brief a CISO on progress in the afternoon, without losing credibility in either room. You listen before you troubleshoot. You ask sharp questions to understand what's actually going on before you propose a fix, then deliver. You communicate clearly and often. Customers always know where things stand. You're focused on success. Not just at renewal time — all the time. You care whether customers succeed, and it shows in how you show up. You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — especially agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You thrive in ambiguity. Requirements 2–5 years' experience in a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer role at a SaaS or cybersecurity company. Passion and interest in agents, how organisations are utilising them, their security and risk, and their governance. Solid technical fluency — comfortable with agent architectures, agent security, agent tooling, APIs, SaaS/cloud integrations, and cloud environments. Proven track record of owning post-sale relationships with enterprise customers, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal. Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues, including coordinating with engineering teams on fixes. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work confidently with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders. Strong discovery and problem-solving skills — able to get to the root of a customer issue quickly. Comfortable delivering polished, tailored product walkthroughs and training sessions independently. Highly organised, with rigorous attention to detail across documentation, account health tracking, and follow-through. Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment. Based in the United Kingdom, with the right to work in the UK, and the flexibility to travel to customer sites as needed. Nice to Haves Experience supporting security, AI/ML, or agentic tooling customers. Active experience creating, deploying and managing agents. Prior experience at a high-growth Series A–B SaaS company. Light scripting or coding ability (e.g. Python) and comfort working with API tools such as Postman. Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Azure, or equivalent). Why This Role AI agents are changing how enterprises operate — and the question of how to govern them safely is becoming mission-critical. Geordie is the platform companies are turning to for that answer. As one of our first Technical Account Managers, you won't just be running a playbook — you'll be writing it. You'll have real influence over how we onboard, support, and grow our customers, and a direct line to Product on what to build next. If you want to go deep on a hard technical problem and build something that matters, this is it. title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
description: We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you. WHY DISTANCE? At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics. There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA , Supacat , and Galvion , and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland. THE ROLE The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces. Your core responsibilities include: Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase. Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit. Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase. You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product. You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams. New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs. A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count. OUR EXPECTATIONS What we're looking for: A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk. At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts. Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly. Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software. You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces. Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial. Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then. It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level. You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English. DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED? Apply via the application form. Our recruitment process includes 2-3 discussions with the team. If you want to learn more about the position, reach out to our recruiter, Joel Kinnunen, at We process your application data only for this recruitment and in line with applicable data privacy law. A Company That Matters

Insurance exists to support people at their most vulnerable, after an accident, illness, theft, fire, or crisis. Claims are the moment of truth. That's why we're passionate about making every claim more empathetic, more efficient, and more human.

ClaimSorted is an AI-native Third Party Administrator that manages claims operations for insurers across auto, property, travel, gadget, pet, renters, and liability. We combine world-class claims talent with proprietary AI systems to deliver dramatically faster resolutions, lower leakage, and a fundamentally better customer experience.

Backed by Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo, we've raised $16M+ and already manage more than $200M in insurance premium, including publicly traded companies and some of the most well-known household names.

The Role

You'll work directly with the founders on the things that hold a fast-growing company together: how we operate day to day, how we hire, and how it feels to join us. Broad scope, real ownership, from your first month.

  • Define how ClaimSorted operates day to day — the cadence, processes and tools that keep a fast-growing team coordinated as we scale.

  • Own the candidate and employee experience end to end, and build the systems that keep it consistently high.

  • Set the standard for how ClaimSorted communicates, internally and out — voice, templates, response times.

  • Act as the first filter on our hiring pipeline: run screening calls and shape the founders' shortlist.

We love working together in the office, so this is a full-time, office-based role in our London office. We're a high-intensity team and often put in significant time and effort, because we believe great outcomes come from doing the work well.

Qualifications

  • 0–3 years somewhere you had to organise people and juggle priorities — startup, accelerator, consulting, VC, or a previous founder associate seat.

  • You hold several priorities at once and know which one matters today.

  • You fix processes rather than absorbing them.

  • Naturally good with people, and quick to build rapport.

  • Excellent writing. Much of this role is writing on behalf of the company.

  • Proficient with AI tools.

Our Values

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'

  • Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

About the Interview

  • Screening call (20 min) with the hiring manager

  • Technical (45 min) – a real ClaimSorted problem, worked live: triage a week of competing priorities and draft the candidate-facing communications that go with it

  • Founder interview (30 min) – how you think about ownership, priorities, and people

  • Team day (paid) – come and work with us for a day

Benefits (UK)

  • Generous, transparent equity participation

  • Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

  • Private medical insurance

  • Pension contributions in line with UK auto-enrolment requirements

  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • 30 days of remote work annually

  • Skilled Worker visa sponsorship

  • Company offsites

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

Compensation: £60K – £110K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

Ready to grow your claims career faster than the traditional industry allows?

We’re looking for a Property Claims Handler to join ClaimSorted.

This role is ideal for:

  • a Claims Handler who wants to build their career at a company that rewards performance, not tenure

  • someone with 6+ months of claims experience who is hungry to learn and grow fast

We are not looking for tenure for the sake of it. We are looking for people with talent, ambition, work ethic, and the drive to build a real career.

If you join us, we will give you the training and support to become the best Claims Handler possible - from people management to performance management, data, quality, and capacity planning. Our goal is to help you become one of the best claims leaders of the future.

About ClaimSorted

ClaimSorted is a Third-Party Administrator (TPA) that manages insurance claims end to end on behalf of insurers, in a ~$200B industry.

We combine a high-performing claims team with an AI-enabled platform to deliver claims up to 3x faster, with better service and better economics for insurers.

We’re backed by Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo, have raised $16M+, and already manage claims for 30+ insurers across more than $200M in insurance premiums.

What you’ll do

  • Handle claims end to end: from first notification of loss through to settlement

  • Communicate with policyholders throughout the claims journey, ensuring a clear and positive experience

  • Review documentation, verify coverage, and assess liability accurately

  • Set appropriate reserves and manage claims within your authority

  • Identify potential fraud indicators and escalate appropriately

  • Maintain accurate and thorough claims records for audit and compliance

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by flagging process inefficiencies

What we’re looking for

  • Based in or willing to relocate to UK or Ireland with work authorization

  • 2+ years of property claims experience (buildings, contents, renters, commercial, or personal property)

  • Strong organisation and ability to prioritise independently

  • Comfortable using data to make decisions

  • Team-oriented, hardworking, and ambitious

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coaching others is a plus

  • Startup or high-growth experience is a plus

Why join us

This is a chance to grow faster than you would at a traditional insurer or claims business.

You’ll get real responsibility, real training, and the opportunity to build your career in a high-performance environment that rewards talent and hard work.

If you’re ready to step up, work hard, and build a career in claims, we’d love to hear from you.

Our Values

  • Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimise for momentum.

  • Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

  • Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

  • Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for ‘good enough.’

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary beyond the industry standard

  • Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

  • Equity participation: stock options as an early-stage team member

  • Private Medical insurance

  • Pension with 3% Company Match

  • 20 - 28 Days Paid time off

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

Compensation: £28K – £33K • Offers Equity • 15% Quaterly Bonus

description: <p><strong>We see the world differently at Capstone Investment Advisors. The work will directly support sizing, trade expression, hedging, portfolio construction and capital allocation - helping drive better decisions, more efficient capital and more repeatable alpha.</p> <p>You will work closely with Risk Managers, Portfolio Managers, Quant Research and the wider Technology, Data and AI teams. Our commitment to a nondiscriminatory approach extends equal opportunities for employment and advancement across our programs, departments, and locations. We actively seek and appreciate a variety of life experiences and heritages and advocate for the amplification of all voices.</p> <p>At Capstone, we're all about creating a workplace where you can thrive and make a real impact. deliverables.</li> <li>Building trusted working relationships with mid-level client teams, confidently facilitating meetings, leading interviews, capturing key insights and helping maintain momentum across project activities.</li> <li>Participating in strategic new business pitches and initiatives, including preparing sections of proposals and identifying add-on opportunities within existing client relationships.</li> <li>Keeping abreast of developments in marketing transformation, modern operating models, organizational change, AI and marketing effectiveness, actively contributing to the team’s knowledge base and thought leadership.</li> <li>Acting as a role model for your grade, supporting Analysts and Consultants, helping onboard new colleagues and contributing to a positive, inclusive and high-performing project environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills, Attributes and Attitude:</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of experience in consulting, client-side strategy, marketing transformation, organizational change or a related field.</li> <li>Emerging specialist expertise in one or more areas of marketing transformation such as operating model design, organizational design, change management, capability building, employee experience, process design or AI-enabled marketing transformation.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesise quantitative and qualitative inputs, identify key trends and develop clear, actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a high-performing team.</li> <li>Understanding of, and interest in, behavioural science and the principles of behaviour change.</li> <li>Able to prepare and lead client interviews, workshops and meetings, using active listening to draw out insight, align stakeholders and move teams toward practical outcomes.</li> <li>Comfort challenging conventional views and presenting ideas persuasively to gain buy-in from clients and colleagues.</li> <li>A strong understanding of modern marketing organisations and how brands, capabilities, technology, data, process and culture come together to drive growth and effectiveness.</li> <li>Curiosity about AI and its impact on marketing transformation, with the ability to identify opportunities to use AI tools and methodologies to improve insight, efficiency and project workflows.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the energy, pragmatism and flexibility to thrive in a fast-moving consulting environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Ogilvy Consulting</strong></p> <p>Ogilvy Consulting is different from other consultancies: we bridge strategy and execution, rigour and creativity. We are nestled at the heart of Ogilvy and the broader WPP network, which means we can bring together consulting, creative, data, technology, media and experience expertise to help clients move from strategy to implementation. We’re also organised differently, with a flat hierarchy designed to provide opportunities for meaningful contributions by team members at all levels. Alongside Marketing Transformation, we work across brand strategy, innovation, sustainability and behavioural science, and all team members have the opportunity to contribute to integrated projects across the Ogilvy Consulting team.</p> <p>Ogilvy Consulting has adopted a flexible working approach, with the ability to work from home and three days per week expected in the office with the team.</p> <p>We are a deeply passionate group who enjoy the challenges and rewards of Consulting work in equal measures.&nbsp;We are looking to scale the team with&nbsp;talent&nbsp;who are as ambitious as they are rigorous and innovative – people who see themselves advancing according to merit and&nbsp;are&nbsp;open to seizing the opportunities our&nbsp;fast-moving growth environment offers.&nbsp;If this sounds like you, please get in touch.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How we help you Thrive:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave + 1 Volunteer Day&nbsp;</li> <li>Bupa Healthcare&nbsp;</li> <li>Enhanced Maternity, Adoption and Shared Parental Leave&nbsp;</li> <li>We have a Flexible Working Model with core working hours: 10am – 4pm&nbsp;</li> <li>A 1.5:1 Matching Pension Structure&nbsp;</li> <li>Wellbeing and Health: Up to £25.00 per month towards physical or online exercise class membership, Unmind membership, LifeWorks tool and annual eye tests and development budgets and Wellbeing incentives and activities throughout the year&nbsp;</li> <li>Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work Scheme&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="x_MsoNormal">Our ambition is to attract the very best diverse talent to Ogilvy, and to be the employer of choice in the UK. We want everyone to feel welcome when they join us, and once they’re here, for them to want to stay with us, grow their career, and to feel they belong with us.</p> <p class="x_MsoNoSpacing">We are an equal opportunity employer and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment for everyone who wants to work at Ogilvy. title: B2B - Influencer Marketing - Account Director
description: <h2 style="text-align: center;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Influence Director</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Department:</strong> PR &amp; Influence</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>London&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Contract type:</strong> Fixed-Term (12 months)&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Full Time/Part time:</strong> Full Time&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Working Pattern:</strong> Hybrid</p> <p><strong>Reporting into:</strong> Business Director/Client Partner</p> <h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;">About Ogilvy</span>&nbsp;</h3> <p><span lang="en-US" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Ogilvy UK has been creating iconic ideas that deliver impact at scale for clients ever since David Ogilvy founded the company in 1948. Ogilvy UK specialises in bringing together brand advertising, customer experience marketing, PR, influence and consulting, all fuelled by Behavioural Science. Our world-class award-winning creative campaigns deliver solutions for clients including Sainsbury’s, Argos, , Mondelēz International, Unilever, TK Maxx and Pernod Ricard.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span lang="en-US">&nbsp;</span><span lang="en-US">In 2023, Ogilvy UK celebrated their&nbsp;75th&nbsp;anniversary and was the most awarded agency in Europe. Ogilvy is home to the largest influencer marketing practice globally, and hosts the world’s biggest festival of behavioural science and creativity,&nbsp;Nudgestock&nbsp;– now in its&nbsp;12th&nbsp;year</span><span lang="en-US">.&nbsp;</span></p> <p>Ogilvy’s award-winning influence division is one of the first agencies to develop a specialist ‘Business Influence’ team, integrating the value of influence into the core of Business Marketing operations for clients with a more ‘corporate’ slant or more B2B focus. We’ve had the pleasure of working on world-leading brands such as TCS, Samsung Business, Lloyds Banking, Intel Gaming, Mastercard, EY, and many more.</p> <p>Whilst our work does cover both B2B and B2C elements, corporate and B2B brands have their own unique set of challenges and objectives. We are here to prove that influencer marketing sits at the heart of their solutions, and we need a visionary leader to help us drive this narrative forward.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Resource Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a key leader within the team, overseeing incoming project requests and live campaign work to ensure excellence in delivery.Work closely with the Business Director to effectively manage resource and capacity within the team, ensuring projects have the appropriate team attached and are running efficiently.</li> <li>Mentor, delegate to, and elevate junior team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercial &amp; Strategy Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bring a true commercial mindset, with a keen eye on scoping out projects, tracking profitability, and understanding the costs attached to running our products and campaign types.</li> <li>Actively contribute to and develop tailored Influencer strategies for our B2B and corporate clients: recommend objectives, targets, action plans, influencer selection, content calendars, and budgets.</li> <li>Support additional agency growth projects as required, including leading/supporting new business pitches, market reviews, and title: Senior AI Security Engineer
description: <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus Technologies</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.</p> <p class="p1">Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Firmus AI Cloud</strong></h3> <p class="p1">Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.</p> <p class="p1">It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.</p> <h3 class="p1"><strong>Why Firmus?</strong></h3> <p class="p1">As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.</p> <p class="p1">We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1">Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.</p> <p class="p1">What we build here has impact beyond the business.
