title: Analytics Engineer - Finance
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. Your expertise in Python, <span data-highlighted="true" data-vc="highlighted-text"><span class="_kqswh2mm"><span class="_5pioz8co _189e1dm9 _1il9buyh _19lc184f _d0altlke" data-testid="definition-highlighter">DBT</span></span></span>, SQL, and Databricks will drive operational efficiency, accelerate our month-end close, and deliver strategic insights that inform capital allocation and IPO readiness. This is a greenfield opportunity to own the analytics roadmap, work directly with Finance leadership, and build infrastructure that powers both scaling and compliance, all at a pivotal moment for Mews</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Design and develop analytical features that surface actionable insights for Finance leadership</li> <li>Build, optimise and maintain production-ready ETL/ELT pipelines using DBT, Databricks and SQL</li> <li>Create scalable data models and analytical solutions using modern data modelling techniques</li> <li>Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders</li> <li>Collaborate across Finance to translate business requirements into technical implementations</li> <li>Advocate for modern data practices and continuous improvement of the stack</li> </ul> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <ul> <li>Hands-on production experience building and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines (minimum 3 years)</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL and Python; strong experience with DBT or equivalent modern data transformation tools</li> <li>Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms, or willingness to ramp quickly</li> <li>Strong understanding of data modelling and analytics architecture</li> <li>Comfort working autonomously and managing priorities with ambiguity; ability to break down complex problems</li> <li>Demonstrated commitment to data quality, testing and accuracy; take pride in work that's been thoroughly validated</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> In this role, you'll redesign how Finance approaches data discovery and analysis using AI—not just automating your own work, but building patterns and tools that shape how the whole team questions data and validates insights. You'll use AI to accelerate model development and testing, but critically, you'll actively question what it produces and know when to push back. You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.</li> <li><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to&nbsp;<a class="underline underline underline-offset-2 decoration-1 decoration-current/40 hover:decoration-current focus:decoration-current" href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></li> </ul> <h4>Nice to have</h4> <ul> <li>Experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI</li> <li>Background working with regulated or governed data</li> <li>Experience scaling analytics in fast-growing startups or scale-ups</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Spain</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€46.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€65.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Czechia</div><div class="pay-range"><span>867 000 Kč</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>1 598 000 Kč CZK</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£49,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£55,500 GBP</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">France</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$54,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$65,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar

Engineering Excellence

  • Deploy the Gen-e²™ technology roadmap defined by the CTO: architecture governance, AI governance, and factory standards (agents, prompts, rules, pipelines) across all squads

  • Own the token economics of our delivery, balancing model cost, latency and quality across squads, so “AI-first” means production-grade, not prototype-grade

  • Operate one level above Lead Engineers: arbitrate divergences, challenge local decisions, spot systemic debt and keep the bar rising as execution becomes increasingly agentic

  • Deploy on our most complex client engagements as the senior technical authority: design AI-first architectures and see them through to production-you ship, not slide decks

  • Step in as Tech Lead on client projects when needed: if a mission requires it, you can take the technical lead role directly, ensuring continuity and quality without waiting for a resource to be available

  • Define and enforce engineering standards: CI/CD practices, code reviews, incident management, and security posture across squads

  • Own technical incidents and escalations with clear ownership and post-mortems

People & Community

  • Directly manage Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) and later AI tech leads and - their growth, performance, workload and career paths are yours

  • Own the engineering community’s rituals end to end: critiques, showcases, community days, learning circles and the shared knowledge base that keeps them visible, inclusive and connected to real delivery challenges

  • Foster cross-project collaboration by connecting engineers facing similar challenges, surfacing reusable patterns, and turning field learnings into shared standards

  • Set the community’s norms and health signals: champion psychological safety, experimentation, wellbeing and sustainable pace, and run lightweight pulse checks to catch issues early

  • Build the mentorship engine: create structures and learning pathways for Senior Engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers, and grow the technical leadership bench

  • Operate the hiring process for engineering roles: sourcing strategy, interviews, technical assessments and recommendations to the CTO

  • Partner with delivery and staffing teams to maintain visibility of capacity and utilisation, support staffing decisions, and turn bench time into meaningful learning, R&D or community contribution

Gen-e2 Practice & R&D

  • Feed everything back into Gen-e²: what you learn on live engagements becomes standards, artefacts, prompts and learning paths for the whole firm, in collaboration with international teams

  • Produce and own engineering KPIs: velocity, quality, incident rate, technical debt, and team health; report regularly to the CTO

  • Represent the engineering practice in leadership forums and working groups, communicate regularly on team health and needs, escalate risks promptly, and uphold PALO IT values, confidentiality, information security and professional standards

  • Contribute to pre-sales through technical scoping, estimation, proposal input and executive-level advisory, ensuring commercial promises remain grounded in production-grade engineering reality

Who You Are

  • You bring 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of an engineering organisation or practice (VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Head of Tech, or CTO of a scale-up)

  • You have delivered production-grade AI-first systems, LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration-and you think in token economics (cost, latency, quality tradeoffs) as naturally as you think in code. You master AI coding assistants as a force multiplier: you still code, by choice

  • You have led delivery in complex, client-facing environments (consulting, embedded squads, platform modernisation) with real users, real constraints and real accountability

  • You are a proven people developer and manager, with a track record of scaling engineering practices-not just individuals-through mentorship, community-building and hands-on AI adoption

  • You think in systems and write things down: architecture decisions under uncertainty, ADRs, standards that make quality reproducible

  • You are fluent at every altitude, from engineering stand-ups to leadership forums, and you switch between them in the same afternoon

  • You lead with care and exigence: high expectations held with accountability in a psychologically safe environment

  • You know how to read team signals early: engagement, workload imbalance, burnout risk, retention risk and under-utilisation, and you act with care, clarity and accountability

  • You care about Tech for Good: sustainability, accessibility and responsible AI are embedded in how you build

  • You are comfortable partnering with HR on hiring strategy, interviews, portfolio reviews, offer decisions and talent-pipeline building through community engagement and events

  • Bilingual French/English, English is mandatory for client and international collaboration

  • Nice to have: cloud architecture certifications (AWS SA, GCP/Azure Professional), public speaking or publications on AI-first delivery

  • A demanding yet supportive technical community: code reviews, pair programming, mentoring to raise development craft daily.

  • Gen-e²™ skill ramp-up from week 1, fully integrated onboarding.

  • Funded Microsoft and GitHub certifications.

  • From idea to impact: internal R&D labs, default open source culture, tech conferences, and innovation dojos to experiment and share.

 

…Plus

  • 🌍 Global career opportunities with cross-sector and multi-country missions, connecting 11 offices worldwide.

  • 🏠 Remote-friendly arrangements depending on project needs, alternating client sites and Paris office for team collaboration.

  • 🌱 Impact Academy: training on climate, digital responsibility, and accessibility embedded in everyday practices.

  • 🤝 Solidarity engagements: team volunteering, skills sponsorship, and more.

  • 🥗🩺 Benefits including Swile meal vouchers and Alan health insurance.

Avec Gen-e2™, nous livrons des produits de bout en bout 2 à 3 fois plus vite que les approches traditionnelles , tout en rehaussant le niveau d’excellence en ingénierie. Curieux-se d’en découvrir plus? Lisez notre article The AI-first revolution in Tech: How PALO IT cracked the code of AI-enhanced engineering. En tant que membre clé de notre équipe, vous dirigerez des initiatives d'ingénierie à fort impact, pilotées par l’IA , de la phase de découverte à la livraison . Piloter le contexte engineering (fonctionnel et technique) au sein du référentiel produit, en garantissant transparence et qualité via des templates PR automatisés et le respect des normes documentaires. Réaliser des analyses de risques et menaces , en arbitrant entre performances, confidentialité, durabilité et sécurité. Concevoir et mettre en place des garde-fous dans les pipelines CI/CD (ex. anonymisation des données sensibles, vérification des licences, gates de conformité) pour garantir une qualité de niveau entreprise. Améliorer continuellement les indicateurs clés liés à l’efficacité énergétique, aux coûts cloud et à l’accessibilité des systèmes. Engagement collaboratif Faciliter la collaboration avec les sponsors techniques et les équipes produit , en tant que référent d’expertise technique. Participer aux revues de code, en fournissant des r etours constructifs et des suggestions d'amélioration . Parcours de montée en compétences Gen-e2 dès la semaine 1 et tout au long de votre onboarding. Des certifications Microsoft et GitHub financées dès l’onboarding. De l’idée au partage: lab R&D interne, open source by default, conférences tech et dojos d’innovation pour expérimenter, coder, transmettre. Qui sommes-nous?


Construire. Développer. Pérenniser.

Nous sommes un cabinet de conseil technologique mondial avec une approche d'ingénierie axée sur l’IA, déposée en marque, pour accélérer la livraison de produits numériques et révolutionner la modernisation des plateformes. Nous faisons ce qui est juste, et nous le faisons bien. Nous sommes fiers d’être parmi les New Champions du Forum Économique Mondial et une entreprise certifiée B Corp.

· Nous sommes assez petits pour agir localement, assez grands pour livrer globalement (5 continents, 11 bureaux, plus de 500 experts de plus de 50 nationalités)
· Nous sommes solides et résilients (100 % indépendants et sans dette)
· Nous sommes entrepreneurs et experts passionnés : nous investissons dans ce en quoi nous croyons sincèrement et travaillons en intelligence collective
· Nous sommes positifs, courageux, attentionnés, acteurs et engagés pour l’excellence

Gen-e2

Alors que le marché se contente encore largement de livraisons simplement « augmentées par l’IA », nous avons réinventé le cycle de vie du développement logiciel (SDLC) pour le rendre AI First. Notre approche change la donne en matière de productivité et de qualité, grâce à une collaboration étroite entre l’IA générative et nos meilleurs talents :

  • Nous générons désormais 95 % de l’ensemble du produit — code, documentation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et même le design, le tout propulsé par GitHub Copilot.

  • Avec Gen-e2™, nous livrons des produits de bout en bout 2 à 3 fois plus vite que les approches traditionnelles, tout en rehaussant le niveau d’excellence en ingénierie.

    Curieux-se d’en découvrir plus? Lisez notre article The AI-first revolution in Tech: How PALO IT cracked the code of AI-enhanced engineering.

Votre rôle

Pour notre filiale PALO IT LABS basée à Paris et entièrement axée sur le développement de notre méthodologie Gen-e2, vous serez amené à utiliser des outils d’IA de pointe pour accélérer les cycles de développement et stimuler l’innovation.

En tant que membre clé de notre équipe, vous dirigerez des initiatives d'ingénierie à fort impact, pilotées par l’IA, de la phase de découverte à la livraison. Leadership technique & Architecture

  • Améliorer continuellement les indicateurs clés liés à l’efficacité énergétique, aux coûts cloud et à l’accessibilité des systèmes.

  • Rester informé(e) des tendances du secteur, des technologies émergentes et des meilleures pratiques, et évaluer leur impact potentiel sur les opérations commerciales et la performance de l’équipe.

Vous êtes au bon endroit si

  • Vous avez au moins 6 ans d’expérience en architecture et développement logiciel (Java, .net, Python, React, Angular...) et IA, avec une appétence forte pour la technique et une capacité à être hands-on;

  • Une forte expertise dans la conception et le scaling d’applications cloud-native ou d’architectures AI-First;

  • Une maîtrise approfondie des processus CI/CD, des plateformes cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), des technologies de containerisation, et des pratiques DevSecOps;

  • Une familiarité avec les approches UX-as-Code et la pensée design system;

  • Une capacité à accompagner et mentorer des équipes diverses dans le développement et l’implémentation de solutions techniques;

  • Un anglais fluide et d’excellentes capacités de communication auprès d’audiences techniques comme non techniques.

  • Vous comprenez des principes de prompt engineering pour une interaction optimale des outils d’IA ;

  • Vous avez une connaissance et curiosité élevées des technologies IA/ML, incluant OpenAI API, LangChain, Hugging Face et le context engineering.

  • Vous avez une pensée critique et analytique pour valider et vérifier le code et les solutions générés par l’IA ;

  • Vous avez une volonté permanente d’apprendre et de vous tenir informé de l’évolution rapide du paysage de l’IA ;

  • Vous êtes sensible aux questions sociales, environnementales et Tech For Good et les intégrez dans ce que vous construisez ;

Les profils de nos consultantes et consultants sont tous diversifiés, et nous sommes fier.es de cette richesse. N’hésitez pas à nous contacter si votre profil ne répond pas à 100 % à cette annonce, nous valorisons également:

title: Head of Data
description: About Luo Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions. Luo has built a sophisticated multi-currency payment infrastructure that constantly generates data related to B2B payments, treasury movements, FX pricing and financial reconciliations. We are now looking for a head of data to develop the Data function at Luo, and to enable every team to leverage data in their day-to-day operations and decisions. What you will build will impact every department: finance, operations, product, sales, FX trading, treasury. The role As head of data, you have three core mandates. You work closely with the engineering team to help evolve our databases and decide data models. You work with every business team to understand their data needs in order to deliver the dashboards and data tooling they need to be successful. You are embedded in every product squad to ensure that new features do not compromise existing data systems, and that the dashboards the company already runs on do not silently break. This role requires both strong data engineering skills and the ability to communicate effectively with other teams about business needs. You will report directly to the CEO, who will help you prioritize the development of the Data function at Luo. What you will do Build and own the analytics layer the business runs on: dashboards and steering tools for finance, operations, sales, FX trading, treasury. Help the tech team select and integrate new tools to build Luo's data infrastructure: data lake, data flows, data transformations, dashboarding and reporting pipelines. Make the business teams autonomous. Document data models and train managers to query data within their respective scopes. Review every schema change before it ships, arbitrate the data consequences of product decisions, and guarantee that no existing dashboard or reporting pipeline breaks on product releases. What we're looking for 7+ years of experience working in data. Strong SQL expertise. In-depth experience with Postgres is highly appreciated. Strong data tooling experience. Experience with dbt, BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform data ecosystem is appreciated. Experience with fintech data is appreciated (eg. multi-currency systems, FX exchanges, ledger systems, balance logic and financial reconciliations). Excellent communication skills and ability to create clarity around complex data problems. Fluent French and professional English. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

About Luo

Luo is one of the fastest-growing FX and cross-border payments companies in Africa. We help African businesses pay their international suppliers faster, more transparently, and more competitively than traditional solutions.

As head of data, you have three core mandates.

  • Make the business teams autonomous. Document data models and train managers to query data within their respective scopes.

  • Review every schema change before it ships, arbitrate the data consequences of product decisions, and guarantee that no existing dashboard or reporting pipeline breaks on product releases.

  • 7+ years of experience working in data.

  • Strong SQL expertise. In-depth experience with Postgres is highly appreciated.

  • Strong data tooling experience.

  • Experience with dbt, BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform data ecosystem is appreciated.

title: 📱 Fullstack Developer
description: 🍿 About Staycation For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel. But we see something different. Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them. Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away. Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment. Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment. Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home. Today, Staycation means: 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland 🏨 2,500+ partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be. ✨ The role We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team. You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers. Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability. We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack. You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin , our CTO & Head of Product. 📍 Key responsibilities Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend. Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification. Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change. Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement. Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt. Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time. Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop. 🧰 Our tech environment Four products running on a shared stack: The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel. The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes. The hotel extranet , where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots. The internal admin platform , the tool our teams use to run the marketplace. On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform. 📌 Key results In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to: Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows. Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production. Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production. Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement. Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design. In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to: Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad. Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business. Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility. Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team. At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others. 🌍 Location This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France , with two possible working arrangements: If you are based in the Paris region , you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office. If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month). 🚀 Why join us? Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience. Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey. Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design. Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma. Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working. Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris. 🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you: Must-haves Have already shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment. We care more about the scope you have handled than an exact number of years or a specific degree. Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger. Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack , as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack . Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL . Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way. Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact. Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design. Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support. Nice-to-haves Experience with React Native . Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey. Previous experience working remotely. Comfortable working in English in a professional environment. ⚙️ Hiring process Recruiter interview with Mathieu , our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min) Manager interview with Robin , our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie , one of our Lead Developers (60 min) Technical interview with Corentin and Joachim , our Tech Leads (60 min) Final meetings with members of our Leadership team (60 min) and your potential future teammates (30 min) In the meantime, meet Robin, our CTO & Head of Product: Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Embedded AI
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while giving them access to the key financial information they need to make the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to: 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself. The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot : invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot. Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production. By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI , you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust. HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement. You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations. You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot. You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance. You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior. You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost. You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience. You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model. You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines. You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value. WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane Within one month: You will learn about Pennylane, our users, our accounting workflows and our AI vision during onboarding. You will get familiar with our ML stack, production systems, datasets, metrics and ways of working. You will meet your product and engineering partners and contribute to a first scoped improvement. Within 3 months: You will own an Embedded AI use case end to end, with clear offline and production metrics. You will have shipped a meaningful improvement to a Copilot or Autopilot capability. You will be comfortable with our technical stack, including Python, Pytorch, PySpark, Redshift, Airflow, AWS SageMaker and our monitoring tools. You will use real user feedback and error analysis to prioritize the next iterations. Within 6 months: You will lead larger cross-team ML projects and help shape the Embedded AI roadmap. You will improve the reliability, automation coverage and maintainability of one or more production systems. You will share best practices and raise the bar for ML engineering, evaluation and production ownership across the team. And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane. Who are we looking for? You may be a great fit if you: Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python. Have hands-on experience building and operating machine learning systems at scale in production — not only training models or running notebooks. Know how to frame an ambiguous product problem, establish a baseline and select useful metrics before optimizing a model. Have strong experience in several of these areas: document AI, NLP, classification, ranking, recommendation, anomaly detection, deep learning or generative AI. Care about data quality, observability, failure modes, cost and long-term maintainability as much as model performance. Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, and communicate well with software engineers, product managers and non-technical domain experts. Are fluent in English; French is not mandatory. Nice to have: Experience with accounting, fintech or other high-trust business workflows. Experience with human-in-the-loop systems, active learning or learning from user corrections. Experience running ML systems at scale with strict latency, reliability or cost constraints. Familiarity with multimodal or generative models for document understanding. What does the recruitment process look like? A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager A case study interview covering problem framing, data, modeling, evaluation, deployment and monitoring (75 min) A past project interview to discuss your experience and technical decisions (60 min) An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (30 min) 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos.   • 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. A growing share of the work done inside our product will be automated or assisted by AI. Our strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product, an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs, and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself.

The Embedded AI team owns the first layer. We build the specialized machine learning systems behind Copilot and Autopilot: invoice parsing, document classification, accounting suggestions, matching, scoring, Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is our ability to frame the right problem, use Pennylane’s data and accounting knowledge, evaluate quality on real workflows, and operate reliable systems in production.

By joining us as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI, you will turn difficult accounting problems into trusted ML products used every day. You will combine strong ML engineering, product thinking and production ownership to improve both automation and user trust.

HOW you will contribute as a Machine Learning Engineer — Embedded AI

You will join the Embedded AI team within our ML & AI organization. The team works closely with product squads and accounting experts, from initial exploration to production, monitoring and continuous improvement.

  • You will design and ship ML systems for document understanding, extraction, classification, matching, ranking, scoring and recommendations.

  • You will contribute directly to our Copilot and Autopilot experiences, including Bookkeeping Autopilot and Revision Autopilot.

  • You will own the full lifecycle of your solutions: problem framing, data and labeling strategy, baselines, training, evaluation, deployment, experimentation, monitoring and maintenance.

  • You will turn user corrections and production failures into better datasets, models and product behavior.

  • You will define quality metrics that reflect real user value: precision and recall, automation coverage, straight-through processing, human correction rate, latency and cost.

  • You will partner with Product, Engineering and accounting experts to understand workflows, define what “correct” means and integrate ML naturally into the user experience.

  • You will choose the simplest reliable approach for each problem — deterministic logic, classical ML, deep learning or generative AI — rather than starting from a preferred model.

  • You will help improve our shared ML engineering practices: reusable components, experimentation, observability, data quality and reliable training and inference pipelines.

  • You will stay ahead of the curve by monitoring emerging ML and AI techniques — including multimodal and generative models — and applying them when they create measurable value.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

This means opportunities to mentor new team members, lead major product initiatives and help define the technical standards that make trusted AI possible at Pennylane.
